To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we have computed the two-loop jet-function for a heavy quark; (2) this jet-function is universal and can be used to resum all large logs in top-jet production; and (3) the jet-function is related to the cusp-anomaly by a top-mass scheme that is suitable for measurements.
the top quark mass is a physical observable in a jet-based scheme, and that the cusp anomalous dimension is the key ingredient to resum the top mass distribution at NNLL order.
the top-jet-function at two loops can be computed in a mass-independent scheme, and that the anomalous dimension can be computed to all orders in the cusp-anomaly.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a framework to describe the production of top-quark pairs at the ILC.
the development of new methods for the computation of multi-loop integrals, and the application of these methods to precision physics at the ILC.
a next-to-next-leading log resummation of the top-invariance mass distribution.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the top quark jet function at NNLO is known, and that the top mass scheme is well defined and has been used for the first time in the literature.
we have a complete and consistent description of all large logs in the top-jet invariant mass distribution.
we are ready for a next-to-next to leading order resummation of the top mass distribution at the LHC, which is a very important step towards the extraction of the Higgs mass.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to determine the top quark mass from the invariant mass spectrum to all orders in the strong coupling.
the top quark is a heavy quark in the sense of effective field theory.
the top quark jet function is a cusp-anomalon, i.e. it has the same anomalous dimension as the top quark forward-scattering amplitude.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the two-loop jet-function can be written as an integral over the one-loop jet-function, and that the integral can be computed using the method of regions.
a top-jet function exists and can be computed in a top mass scheme.
a top-mass scheme can be used in top-jet analyses, and the cusp anomalous dimension can be used to resum the large logarithms.
